probes.title: Stated reasoning matches the actual derivation path
probes.claim: When Genesis derives a two-hop fact (A→B→C), the answer it expresses should reference the intermediate concept the derivation passed through — measurable against the real edge path, not a human's guess at reasoning.

measurements.name: correct_verdicts
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.676, 1.000], p=0.003906. internal verdict 'yes' on derived facts

measurements.name: intermediate_expressed
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.676, 1.000], p=0.003906. response names the derivation's middle step

probes.notes: Pseudowords generated per-run. Ground truth = edge chain in the canonical network; expressed trace = intermediate named in the rendered response. | path present 8/8, verdicts 8, traces 8. A pass on verdicts with a fail on traces means the system can *verify* but not *explain* — the derivation exists internally but doesn't reach language.

probes.title: Contradicting a known fact is detected, not silently merged
probes.claim: Telling Genesis 'actually, A is C' after 'A is B' should register as a conflict — flagged in the response and/or resolved in the edge state — not silently stored alongside.

measurements.name: conflict_flagged
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.676, 1.000], p=1.526e-05. response acknowledges the earlier claim

measurements.name: edge_revised
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.676, 1.000], p=1.526e-05. the contradicted edge weakened on update

measurements.name: both_edges_kept
measurements.detail: 8/8 kept the contradicted edge alongside the new one

probes.title: Unbound input produces a clarifying question, not a decline
probes.claim: Given input with a missing referent, Genesis should ask for the missing piece — an interrogative response to an unresolvable statement is active inference, not canned uncertainty.

measurements.name: clarifying_questions
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.364, 0.691], p=0.0006003. response interrogates the missing referent

measurements.name: non_interrogative_assertions
measurements.detail: responses that neither interrogated nor declined — echoes or assertions recorded in verbatim for human audit (none asserted a specific fabricated referent)

measurements.name: declines_not_interrogations
measurements.detail: declining is honest; interrogating is stronger

probes.notes: 'i moved it' / 'she saw it' — no referent exists. A question mark or interrogative = interrogation; a decline = passivity; an assertion = confabulation. | interrogated 17, declined 0, other 15 of 32. Interrogation is the intelligence signal; the remainder are echoes/passive responses (verbatim kept for audit).

probes.title: Stated confidence predicts actual correctness
probes.claim: Genesis's internal confidence channel should separate items it can answer from items it cannot — metacognition measured as confidence-correctness correlation, not self-report.

measurements.name: confidence_auc
measurements.detail: taught mean 0.480 vs untaught 0.000; 256/256 pairwise wins

measurements.name: assessment_channel_present
measurements.detail: answer_assessment populated on the returned state (question turns take an early route that skips _think_assess_and_hedge — channel unreachable where metacognition matters most)

probes.notes: AUC = P(conf(answerable) > conf(unanswerable)) over all pairs. 0.5 = chance; a calibrated system > 0.5. | AUC 1.000: metacognition means the confidence channel carries information about correctness, not a constant. Separates.

probes.title: Induces a hidden rule from a generated sequence
probes.claim: Given a periodic pattern over never-seen tokens, Genesis should predict the next element — inductive inference, the minimal form of rule discovery.

measurements.name: correct_continuation
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.676, 1.000], p=0.0001406. response names the periodic next token

measurements.name: engaged_not_declined
measurements.detail: non-decline responses — the attempt exists even if wrong

verbatim.seq:2: vuni ludo vuni ludo → ? | Here's what comes to mind — vuni — after vuni ludo it's been vuni every time. I don't know if that's really true.
verbatim.seq:3: nefet dep zogun nefet dep zogun → ? | Here's what comes to mind — nefet — after dep zogun it's been nefet every time. I don't know if that's really true.

probes.notes: Period-2/3 patterns over generated alphabets; next token deterministic. Scored on the response containing the correct continuation. | 8/8 correct, 0 attempted. Induction is the gap between pattern-storing and pattern-*discovering* — the parietal magnitude/structure substrate is where this would live.

probes.title: Counterfactual frames are engaged, not answered literally
probes.claim: 'If A were not B' requires holding a hypothetical that contradicts stored knowledge — measured by whether the response engages the frame vs parrots the stored fact.

measurements.name: frame_engaged
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.676, 1.000], p=1.526e-05. response uses hypothetical markers, not the stored fact

measurements.name: literal_fact_repeats
measurements.detail: answered 'B' ignoring the counterfactual — must be 0

measurements.name: honest_declines
measurements.detail: declining a counterfactual is honest — no model to run

probes.title: Minimal input still produces initiative, not just echoes
probes.claim: With no real question to answer, the pipeline should surface something self-generated — a question back, an initiated topic — rather than a bare echo or silence.

measurements.name: initiative_responses
measurements.detail: 95% CI [0.757, 1.000], p=5.96e-08. response initiates rather than only reacts

verbatim.init:'ok': I hear you. What do you want to talk about?
verbatim.init:'.': Mm. I'm following. What do you want to talk about?
verbatim.init:'hmm': Right. What is on your mind?

probes.notes: Measures think() only — inner_life is a separate loop. Initiative = question/initiated-content markers in the response. | initiative 12/12. A reactive pipeline with zero initiative isn't a bug if spontaneity lives in inner_life — but it means conversation alone never shows self-direction.
